stem: The research institute publishes new material on its Web site well in advance of its appearance in print; inevitably, there is a lot of dross, but fortunately, much of the material is both ____ and free.

At first glance, each of the stories in the anthology seemed (i)____, upon closer inspection of their protagonists, implied morals, and fantasy elements, however, subtle similarities among the stories emerged to (ii)____ this initial observation.
colsZh: 引人入胜的；有说服力的

stem: During Nigeria's colonial period, the country’s Igbo societies had (i)____ sense of gender distinctions, but the idea of a strict division of labor along gender lines (ii)____. Indeed, the social roles of women and men were quite (iii)____, based on what people did rather than on existential categories like gender.
Once deemed too ____ the big bang model of the birth of the universe has turned out to be one of the most robust scientific theories, with experimental verification going back billions of years.
optsZh: 大胆的；无礼的；乐于冒险的；大胆创新的
含糊的、不确定的；有多种理解方式的

stem: Gaige accomplishes a surprising feat: modeling her novel on one of the most ____ narratives in all of literature, she creates a remarkably understated tale.
optsZh: 轰动的；耸人听闻的；极好的

stem: When discussing the United States Army's 1876 campaign against the Sioux, Powers is occasionally ____ context: he describes General Crook's march to the Battle of the Rosebud but neglects to mention how it fit into the army's overall strategy.
